detour_definition: SPEC §6 defines the unnecessary detour against the same-endpoint Manhattan lower bound.  A 90-degree arc can be shorter than the L1 bound (arc length R*pi/2 < 2R for the same displacement), so this quantity may be slightly negative for arc-routed connections; it is reported as defined and NOT treated as an error.  The additional unnecessary_detour_vs_euclidean_mm is always >= 0 and is the true geometric detour length.
crossing_points_note: full crossing list is not embedded (size); recompute with four_side_1024.fslw.metrics.compute_pair_audit for figures

route_length_density.definition: sampled centreline length per 5 x 5 mm cell (mm per cell)

port_region.definition: ports_total = 4 sides x 16 connectors x 16 columns = 256 per side; routed_endpoints counts routed route endpoints per side; port_band_length_mm is the centreline length inside the 5 mm band along each edge

propagation_loss.optical_loss_scope: propagation-only; bend loss and crossing loss are unknown_uncalibrated

bend_loss.note: no femtosecond-laser-written glass bend-loss function is known; R=40 mm is a geometry constraint only, not a measured loss value

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing count is a geometric metric only

total_optical_loss.note: total optical loss cannot be reported until glass bend loss and crossing loss are calibrated; propagation loss alone is reported explicitly

legacy_polymer_estimate.note: the previous polymer bend-loss model may be quoted for comparison only, never as glass truth

legacy_arm.note: the legacy polymer bend-loss model is NOT presented as glass truth and no legacy numbers are embedded here

optical_loss_breakdown.other_losses_note: no other loss terms are modelled

symmetry.source: four_side_1024.abcd.connectivity.symmetry_maps semantics (local plane kernel; abcd.metrics transform helpers)
symmetry.note: per-plane subset: row1->z1 (opposite) / row2->z2 (adjacent); endpoint-level symmetry is a topology property, structurally limited on V1 and only partially complete on V2 - this is not a routing defect
